author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
Brilliant platformer with great mechanics and physics with  lots of power ups. Great puzzles and challenges with good boss fights. Lots of cameos from memorable Playstation charachters.

Honestly at 10-14 hours it's perfect as it does not overstay it's welcome.

I genuinely have nothing negative to say.

10/10

author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
For me in AC4 Black Flag the boats were slow and cumbersome they had weight and were not easy to manoeuvre, the cannons took time to reload, you had to fight the current of the water and the wind all of this was brilliant as it added so much to the realism. All of that is gone in S&B and the boats they move on a sixpence and instead of feeling like being in command of a ship you feel like you're playing with a toy boat in the bath.

The game is dull and bland.

author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
Really dissapointed with this game for the money it cost, it's buggy/glitchy with some slow downs and CTD's which seems to be the norm for wrestling games but is not acceptable.

The big hype around this game was it's old skool like No Mercy (N64) and this is nothing like it my biggest gripe is around how the game feels/plays it's like it's missing frames of animation it's not smooth it feels like when you initiate a grapple the wrestlers just magnetize together then you press the button and it's like it runs the script and plays the animation, there is just something off with how this feels.

Small roster that only the most die hard AEW fans will know with no real legends to lean on (fairly new company) and several omissions.

I just cannot recommend this for the price and how quickly you will get bored because of the lack of depth and replayability, The game should really of been $20 with a $10 season pass for DLC wrestlers. Wait for a sale or hope they do better next time.

author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
Bugs, Low FPs and not really what I thought I was getting.
The big issue for me is it's not that fun, I honestly got bored of the story and dialogue and boring investigation stuff. The game tries to do a lot and it's just not that great at any of them, you can look at other games like GTA, Just Cause, Horizon Zero Dawn, Far Cry, and countless other games that have better mechanics than this it's just not that stand out for one exceptional thing.

I'm afraid it was all hype and to say I am disappointed is an under statement. It's getting Zero (0) for it's bad optimization, they delayed the game and had long enough to get this to a far better playable state.

author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
Just very boring and repetitive, Ai is useless and it's just a kick/punch mashfest, generic shared movesets so don't expect any to perform the same moves the wrestlers do. The roster is not upto date with some bizzare choices/omissions and the wrestlers do not like their real life counterparts. It just feels like a Mobile game.

The game is also filled with microtransactions making some of the modes feel very grindy.

In terms of Wrestling games this is just below WWF Royal Rumble for the Dreamcast which at least had 9 players in the ring.

Not even worth $10 as you will be bore within an hour or so. DO NOT BUY!

author: qsdrdrhy2
quote:
Sega tarnished this by adding Denuvo DRM without listing it on the storefront or in the EULA and are claiming it was a mistake which seems unlikely after a 2 week delay that was rumoured to be because they were adding DRM. It seems they thought they would get away with it, somebody added DRM and yet everyone is claiming not to know.

Unplayable offline, increased HW requirements and larger file size it's just not good enough for a £15 game that is part rehashes of old levels and very short.

Sega is a large corporation that should know better there is no excuse for this they have the resources for this to have not happened, I do not own a console so I have no alternative to play this.

More shady practices by Sega.
